text:
```yaml
name: Check dist

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'dist/**'

jobs:
  check-dist:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Ensure dist/ was not modified
        run: |
          if git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD | grep -q '^dist/'; then
            echo "::error::The dist/ directory was modified in this pull request. This is not allowed for security reasons. Please rebuild the dist/ files using 'npm run build' and 'npm run package'."
            exit 1
          fi
```
